note: Sources: Sciarrino's own works catalogue (salvatoresciarrino.eu), Schott pages (Ligeti, Eötvös), IRCAM Brahms/Ressources entries (Berio, Xenakis, Nono, Scelsi, Dallapiccola, Maderna, Kurtág), IMSLP (Kodály, Dohnányi), Wikipedia work lists. Eötvös died 2024 (dates 1944–2024); Berio, Xenakis, Nono, Scelsi etc. dates as given. Not confirmed: Eötvös 'Now, Miss!' (violin & cello, 2016); Petrassi Duetto (vn/va, 1985); Xenakis Dhipli Zyia (published or not); Scelsi Divertimento years differ between IRCAM (1951/1955/1955) and Wikipedia (1954/1955/1955). Durations for Per Caterina, Serenade für Claudia, Tartiniana, Introduzione e Allegro, Triptic and Signs/Games/Messages left at 0 (unknown). Kurtág Tre pezzi Op. 14e relies on Wikipedia only. Petrassi publishers not confirmed. IRCAM lists an unattributed item 'petits concerts édifiants pour Theo et Gerhard' (violin & tenor vielle) under Kurtág: not verified, left out. Eötvös's own website appeared compromised (spam links) and was not used. Ligeti Sonata for solo viola is viola, not violin, so excluded.
